chunks.text: I’m at the campus library after class, and I’m trying to get my week organized… kinda torn between picking up a drawing course and grabbing a novel to read. The course I had in mind is called Drawing Fundamentals, and the book is To Live.
Yeah, that all sounds right — go ahead and lock both in. The course should be under Luo Fei, and the book hold under Yang Yu.
Oh, and before I forget, I saw a bill reminder pop up on my phone while I was walking out — I’m fine with it being paid now. The bill ID is DL20260219001.
